newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus to auction up to 15 mln in 91-day bills.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus to auction up to 15 mln in 91-day bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus will auction up to 15 million pounds ($29.5 million) in 91-day treasury bills with a March 12 issue date, the bank said on Tuesday.
Bids, which can be competitive or non-competitive, can be made from March 11 to March 12 at 9.00 a.m. (0700 GMT).
Competitive bids will be accepted in part or in whole if the price is equal or higher than that set by the central bank.
Those making non-competitive bids will pay the average price of all bids submitted and accepted by the central bank. ($=0.51 pounds)-- Nicosia newsroom 357 2 365089
